item.text:
Subject: Proposal to Circulate Meeting Notes

Dear Club Members,

Could we agree to circulate meeting notes within two days of each meeting? A prompt summary would help everyone remember decisions and action items while discussions are still fresh. It would also give members who were absent a timely way to catch up and contribute. I’m happy to help prepare or review the notes so this process remains manageable for everyone.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
